admission.justification: The recorded behavioral fixture assertions guard this obligation; the proof facets distinguish their limited fixture behavior from real-host or full-final acceptance.

applicability: Native retirement of a Worker, Reviewer or Curator by the recorded original starter, and the liveness check that steps a seat up.
conditions: Resolve all matching current and archived receipts before any archive effect.
Require the original starter even for a repeat reporting already-retired.
An active turn requires explicit interruption permission.
More than one matching record in any current/history mix is refused before any archive effect, with no host call and no disk write, so target uniqueness survives alongside starter authorization.

A seat whose publication shows a running subagent is retired or replaced only with the word that its work may be interrupted, and the refusal names the subagent; a step-up never interrupts a holder that has one.
exclusions: Dashboard replacement, which has a separate checked launch entry.
Task acceptance or leaf-close archival debt.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_native_retire.py::NativeRetireTests::test_a_current_plus_history_record_is_refused_without_effects passes; scratch/worker/5e0b3a10-7a35-4c5e-9f11-100000000001/xdg/r6-probe-final0.txt sha c484e288071f: ambiguous-agent, no archive, receipt bytes unchanged

statement: Retirement enumerates every matching current and archived record first and refuses an agent recorded more than once, in any mix, with no host call and no disk write; starter authority is verified before retirement and idempotent success. A seat whose publication shows a running subagent is retired or replaced only with the word that its work may be interrupted, and it is busy for a step-up, which never interrupts it.
